content.text: I always get a kick out of intentionally mispronouncing your name
“What about this Dan Gr-EYE-sbaum guy? How long did he work there?” I’ll ask people
Ha- that’s a good idea actually. I assume most responses are “since Moses wore shorts pants”

OK, so I’m gonna shoot you names. What I’m looking for is a recommendation on how to reach out to these people, since you know them. Either in-person, phone or text. I’d prefer not to text but it’s always an option.
Bagley, Barnett, Decker (I texted her a couple times last year, no response), Langolf
I don’t know if you were reading between the lines a couple nights ago, but I went knocking on doors

I think all 4 would be best with a phone call. Not sure if any will give you much or not but Bagley and Langolf are most likely to be helpful I think. I think text is ok for explaining your intentions (just an anon survey, etc). Yes I gathered that. Anyone answer?
What about the women who still work there, Amy Churchill, Casey Shauman and Betsy Bouillon
I’ve got the sense they’re a little closer to the situation. Like, they’ve seen a lot but they aren’t confrontational

Yea I think they would be scared. I don’t personally understand what their problem is. With the money they make (not much) and being women (companies are trying to diversify as much as possible now), I just don’t comprehend how they could still be working there
Yeah I’ve heard they both see and hear a lot
